# Pure Latency

> Pure Latency is a technology company based in Hyderabad, India, providing AI, IT, and infrastructure services, and building its own proprietary products, for enterprises, telcos, government, and space-tech clients.

## Services

- [Applications](https://purelatency.com/services/applications): Custom web and mobile application development, from discovery through launch and support.
- [Web Development](https://purelatency.com/services/web-development): Websites and web applications built with modern frameworks (React, Next.js) and cloud deployment.
- [Data and AI](https://purelatency.com/services/data-ai): Data pipelines, machine learning, and AI system development, including generative AI and conversational AI integration.
- [Cloud and DevOps](https://purelatency.com/services/cloud-devops): Cloud infrastructure automation, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.
- [Infrastructure](https://purelatency.com/services/infrastructure): IT infrastructure design, deployment, and management for enterprise environments.
- [Quantum Compute](https://purelatency.com/services/quantum-compute): Early-stage / by inquiry — quantum computing consulting and algorithm exploration, not yet an established production practice.
- [Fiber Optics](https://purelatency.com/services/fiber-optics): Early-stage / by inquiry — fiber optic network installation and testing services, offered on a project-inquiry basis.

## Products

- [Starling Post](https://purelatency.com/products/starling-post): Pure Latency's proprietary product.

- [About Pure Latency](https://purelatency.com/about): Company overview, purpose, and beliefs.
